newsitem.title: USA: Avecor files with FDA for blood pump.
newsitem.headline: Avecor files with FDA for blood pump.

text.p: Avecor Cardiovascular Inc said it filed a 510(k) application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration seeking clearance to market its new Affinity blood pump in the United States.
The company said the pump handles blood better and more efficiently than older roller pumps and centrifugal pumps, which are currently used in heart/lung bypass surgery.
Pending FDA clearance, the company said it intends to introduce the new pump in the United States during the first half of 1997.
The company said it has already introduced the pump to its European sales force and distributor network, and plans to conduct European clinical trials during the fourth quarter of 1996.
Avecor makes several components used in heart-lung bypass circuits, which are used in most open-heart surgeries.
Shares in the company were off 1/4 to 14-1/2.
